answer.text: somewhere between a third and a half
answer.line: Paragraph 10, sentence 4: unresponsiveness to speech appears at perhaps a third to a half of MAC.

steps: Find the effect the stem names: unresponsiveness to speech, paragraph 10, sentence 4.
Read its dose: "perhaps a third to a half of MAC".
Keep the ladder straight. Amnesia at about a quarter, speech at a third to a half, stillness at full MAC.

choices.note: About a quarter of MAC is where amnesia appears, one rung lower on the same ladder in sentence 5.
No effect in the passage is tied to a tenth of MAC.

choices.text: somewhere between a third and a half
choices.note: Above amnesia at a quarter, below stillness at full MAC: a third to a half.

choices.text: the full value of MAC and nothing less
choices.note: Full MAC is defined by movement: half of patients do not move when the skin is cut. Unresponsiveness to speech comes well before that.

choices.text: roughly twice the value of MAC
choices.note: No effect is placed at twice MAC. The brain alone needing far more agent to stop movement is a different measurement.

lockIt: Close numbers: match the effect to its own dose. The trap is usually the neighbour's number.
